title: EduEval: A Hierarchical Cognitive Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Chinese Education
findings: The paper does not provide any specific findings related to religion or faith, as it is not a focus of the benchmark. The only relevant component, 'mythological references', is a small part of a broader task, and its specific results are not isolated or discussed.
